blocks.text: South Surrey Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: South Surrey townhouses cluster in Grandview Heights, between 16 Avenue and 28 Avenue, with the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) to the east, under the Grandview Heights General Land Use Plan.
North Grandview Heights alone covers about 339 hectares south of 32 Avenue, west of Highway 15, east of 156 Street and north of 28 Avenue, bordered by Rosemary Heights to the north.
Morgan Creek, Sunnyside and Elgin townhouse facts shared with house pages: see the sunnyside-park-south-surrey-houses-for-sale and king-george-corridor-south-surrey-houses-for-sale notes.

blocks.text: South Surrey Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: The townhouse form here is set by plan, not by chance: the Orchard Grove plan puts townhouses and rowhouses at 15 to 30 units per acre in the plan interior, as a transition between multi-family housing toward 24 Avenue and single-family houses toward 26 Avenue.

Newer Grandview townhouse sites are zoned Multiple Residential 30 Zone (RM-30) after rezoning from One-Acre Residential Zone (RA), the pattern in the City report for 16468 and 16488 20 Avenue, 1909 165A Street and 16469 19 Avenue.
A second current site, 1935 165A Street, sits across from Ta'talu Elementary School in the Sunnyside Heights plan, with townhouses zoned RM-30 to its north.

blocks.text: South Surrey Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: RM-30 setbacks are the rule a buyer sees on foot: the 20 Avenue application varied the minimum side yard setback in Part 22 RM-30 from 6.0 metres to 3.0 metres for four buildings, by Development Variance Permit.
The Sunnyside Heights Neighbourhood Concept Plan (NCP) designation for the 20 Avenue site is Multiple Residential 30 to 45 units per acre, plus the Grandview Ridge Trail corridor.
North Grandview's 2005 plan amendments were made expressly to allow smaller single-family lots and townhouse development, so townhouse zoning there traces to that amendment, not the 1999 plan.

blocks.text: South Surrey Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Buildings 9, 10 and 11 of application 7918-0153-00 must step with natural grade, and sunken units fronting the Grandview Ridge Trail are not supported by staff, so lower-level light varies by building within one complex.
The 20 Avenue site's east yard interfaces with the Grandview Ridge Trail area conveyed to the City through that same application.

blocks.text: South Surrey Townhomes: costs and taxes

items.t: Surrey's 2026 municipal total for Class 1 residential property is 1.84251 per $1,000 of assessed value, and the all-in total shown on the City rate schedule is 3.42731 per $1,000.

blocks.text: South Surrey Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check the NCP designation before assuming a neighbouring acreage lot stays as-is: the 20 Avenue site's neighbours include acreage single-family lots designated Multiple Residential 10 to 15 units per acre with a townhouse application already at Third Reading.
Check grading on sloped Grandview lots in the strata documents: staff required the applicant to refine grading so units step with natural grade.

faq.a: The cap sits well above the middle of the combined attached market: the S Surrey White Rock Condos & Townhomes median sale price was $700,000 in September 2026 — $500,000 below the cap — though that median mixes condos with townhomes, so treat it as context for where the cap sits, not as the price of a typical townhome (SnapStats, September 2026)
faq.q: Does the $1.2M cap cover the typical South Surrey townhome?

faq.a: The Form B Information Certificate, the bylaws, recent minutes, the budget and the depreciation report. The strata must provide the Form B within one week under the Strata Property Act.
faq.q: What should I check in a townhome's strata documents?

faq.a: Most are strata, either a building strata or a bare-land strata, with monthly fees and bylaws. Some are freehold row homes with no strata. The title search tells you which, and it decides which costs and rules apply.
faq.q: Are townhomes in South Surrey freehold or strata?

faq.a: Read the Form B, the bylaws, the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and ask about exterior repairs, pet and rental rules and who looks after the fences, roofs and yards.
